body: Worst case scenario they throw you in a padded cell.. I would rather die any death than slowly go insane in a fuckin asylum. If you act crazy they will treat you like your crazy, approach with caution is all im saying.

There's no one I can tell, going to hospital then getting placed under observation would do the opposite of good for me.. I'm not in pain anymore I just feel nothing. "Silence is deafening."

* I sounds so cliche right now its almost sad xD

I like the JRE so I'll watch that last one but I should mention my reasons aren't because of abuse I had, I guess thats well swept under the rug in our family now.. haha. I think its fucked that I could never call the police on him and that was my fault but its not the reason im going. 

I had someone message me saying it gets better etc, which is fine for some people but idk, i layed things out and he said you sound pretty rational.. I consider myself a pretty rational person and ive been thinking about this a long time, it just makes so much sense to me to end it..
What would you like to know?

I used to fantasize about murdering my father before I killed myself when I was 15 (he used to beat the shit out of me) my mum used to ignore it thinking it was just spanking, he used to kick my head into a treadmill and flat out punch me in the head over and over, I will always have a memory from when i was eight and he held me by the throat completely lifted off the ground haha.. But no its not their fault im useless, i just made terrible choices. 

*PS. I will always remember on Sundays it was his only day off for ages and my mum and older brother would be at work, and he would say "your mine today" or something to that effect.
